assays.neuron_population: Right GF with LC4/LPLC2-associated population perturbations

assays.stimulus: Projected dark disk 10 to 90 degrees, r/v 10-80 ms; silencing contexts separate
assays.observable: GF voltage waveform, relative components and spikes
assays.baseline: Recorded rest; no holding current; junction correction absent
assays.time_reference: Measured visual onset and loom/TTC reference must be supplied
assays.temporal_resolution: 20 kHz digitization, 10 kHz low-pass, 360 Hz visual projector
assays.population_aggregation: Across-fly traces and silencing-defined components, not per-MaleCNS body
assays.limitations: Unknown source-state/target-scale mapping and experimental stimulus registration

assays.neuron_population: Population LPLC2 stimulation; GF voltage readout

assays.observable: GF current-clamp depolarization, not optical activation magnitude
assays.baseline: No injected current; uncorrected junction potential; per-trial rest needed
assays.time_reference: Optical trigger distinct from visual stimulus onset
assays.population_aggregation: N=4 flies/group; unknown activated-body state distribution
assays.relevance: Connectivity/sign, not k from voltage divided by x
assays.limitations: Actuator expression, illumination and presynaptic activation map unknown

assays.time_reference: Motion onset and offset, acquisition timestamps required
assays.temporal_resolution: Indicator/acquisition filtering; 300 ms peak averaging window, 500 ms post-motion search
assays.population_aggregation: Declared axon/terminal ROI and trial/cell averaging
assays.limitations: Unknown x-to-activity/calcium/indicator transform, RF/body crosswalk and raw data

assays.relevance: Functional LC4 pathway, not direct source x calibration
